requirements.title: IEOR argument restrictions
requirements.definition: I and J shall each be integer or a BOZ literal constant; same-kind integer operands are required, and both operands shall not be BOZ literals.

requirements.definition: The result is the same type and kind as I for integer I; otherwise it is the same type and kind as J.

Result Value paragraph is split into BOZ conversion and exact bit-result obligations.
